metadata.title: Isabella Villaseñor AI Genesis — 500-Point Critical Remediation Checklist
metadata.method: Static forensic repository inspection plus architecture/runtime trace. Dynamic execution was not claimed because the audit environment lacked node_modules and pnpm.
metadata.critical_moe_verdict: Genesis Turbo is a deterministic keyword router/classifier, not a trained neural MoE. The repository also contains native logistic/regression ML and provider routing, but no verified end-to-end top-k learned-gating expert execution path was found in the inspected snapshot.
metadata.important_distinction: The 500 rows are actionable remediation items. CONFIRMADO means directly supported by inspected source/config; FALTA_IMPLEMENTACION means the capability is absent or not evidenced in the inspected surface; REQUIERE_VERIFICACION means runtime/integration evidence is required; BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT means the check could not be executed in this audit environment.
metadata.note_on_documentation: The existence of DOI/documentation is treated as provenance of the work, not as evidence that a runtime claim is technically verified.
